install: set -euo pipefail; if ! command -v swiftc >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/swift/usr/bin/swiftc" ] && [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ] && [ "$(uname -m)" = "x86_64" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.local"; tmp="$(mktemp /tmp/swift.XXXXXX.tar.gz)"; stage="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.local/swift.XXXXXX")"; trap 'rm -rf "$tmp" "$stage"' EXIT; curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$tmp" "https://download.swift.org/swift-6.2.1-release/debian12/swift-6.2.1-RELEASE/swift-6.2.1-RELEASE-debian12.tar.gz"; tar -xzf "$tmp" --strip-components=1 -C "$stage"; rm -rf "$HOME/.local/swift"; mv "$stage" "$HOME/.local/swift"; rm -f "$tmp"; fi; touch "$HOME/.bashrc"; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || true; LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/swift/usr/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'; grep -qxF "$LINE" "$HOME/.bashrc" || echo "$LINE" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; export PATH="$HOME/.local/swift/usr/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; python3 -c "import jwt, cryptography, pypinyin, wordfreq" 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install --user --break-system-packages --no-input --quiet pyjwt cryptography pypinyin wordfreq || python3 -m pip install --user --no-input --quiet pyjwt cryptography pypinyin wordfreq
